## File: facebookresearch_dinov3/dinov3/models/convnext.py

Prompts

```
['build a ConvNeXt model with specified depths and dims for image feature extraction', 'create a ConvNeXt model variant using get_convnext_arch with a size name like convnext_base', 'extract intermediate layer features from a ConvNeXt model with optional normalization and reshaping', 'run forward_features on a ConvNeXt model to get CLS tokens and patch tokens as a list of dicts', 'apply stochastic depth drop path regularization to tensor inputs during training', 'build a DINOv3 ViT-Small vision transformer model with 384 embed dim and 12 layers', 'build a DINOv3 ViT-Base vision transformer model with 768 embed dim and 12 layers', 'build a DINOv3 ViT-Large vision transformer model with 1024 embed dim and 24 layers', 'build a DINOv3 ViT-SO400M vision transformer model with 1152 embed dim and 27 layers', 'build a DINOv3 ViT-Giant2 vision transformer model with 1536 embed dim and 40 layers']
```

Usage

```
{'build_convnext_model': 'build a ConvNeXt model with specified depths and dims for image feature extraction', 'get_convnext_arch': 'create a ConvNeXt model variant using get_convnext_arch with a size name like convnext_base', 'get_intermediate_layers': 'extract intermediate layer features from a ConvNeXt model with optional normalization and reshaping', 'forward_features': 'run forward_features on a ConvNeXt model to get CLS tokens and patch tokens as a list of dicts', 'drop_path_regularization': 'apply stochastic depth drop path regularization to tensor inputs during training'}
```
